alt: 鄰居在花園門口低聲傳話，指著後方遭風損壞的溫室，另一人查看眼前的損壞。
scene_prompt: At a modern community garden gate, two neighbors quietly pass along news with one cupping a hand near the other’s ear while pointing toward the same clearly visible evidence behind them: a windstorm has broken the garden greenhouse glass and scattered potted seedlings. A third neighbor looks where they point and sees the actual fresh damage. Their sober curious expressions are calm, no malicious gossip. Composition must connect the quietly spread report to the unmistakable broken greenhouse that caused it. This specifically illustrates the source dictionary sense 事出有因，流言乘隙而入: a report has an observable underlying cause, not the later opposite sense of groundless fabrication. No speech bubbles, no text, no pictograms.
